content.title: Robinhood, AppLovin, EMCOR joining S&P 500. What does EMCOR do?
content.description:
Robinhood (HOOD), AppLovin (APP), and EMCOR (EME) are joining the S&P 500 (^GSPC) on Monday, Sept. 22 as part of the index's quarterly rebalancing.

While Robinhood and AppLovin are likely to be familiar names among investors, EMCOR may be less well-known. Julie Hyman outlines what EMCOR does.
